# RLHF Reward Model

> Classical RLHF built from scratch: a Bradley-Terry reward model with PPO, a from-scratch DPO implementation and a head-to-head PPO-vs-DPO comparison, and an explicit reward over-optimization study.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model

## Source

- [src/rlhf_reward_model/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/__init__.py): RLHF Reward Model - a Bradley-Terry reward model, PPO, and DPO from scratch.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/cli.py): Command line interface for the RLHF reward-model pipeline.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/comparison.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/comparison.py): A head-to-head comparison of PPO and DPO on the same synthetic preference task.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/domain.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/domain.py): The alignment task: prompts, candidate responses, and a hidden gold reward.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/dpo.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/dpo.py): Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on the log-linear policy.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/evaluation.py): Evaluation for the RLHF pipeline: reward model fidelity and policy improvement.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/overoptimization.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/overoptimization.py): Reward over-optimization (Goodhart's law) as a measured, first-class study.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/pipeline.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/pipeline.py): The end-to-end RLHF pipeline: SFT, reward model, PPO, and evaluation.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/policy.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/policy.py): A log-linear softmax policy over candidate responses.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/ppo.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/ppo.py): PPO-style policy optimization against a learned reward.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/reward_model.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/reward_model.py): A Bradley-Terry reward model fit from pairwise preferences.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the RLHF reward model and policy.
- [src/rlhf_reward_model/sft.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/rlhf-reward-model/blob/main/src/rlhf_reward_model/sft.py): Supervised fine-tuning by behavior cloning.
